title: The sales conversation, objections and complaint recovery

say: The sales conversation, objections and complaint recovery.
This is the video for module 2 of Customer Relations and Sales.
Good selling is not about clever talk or pressure. It is a helpful conversation with a clear direction.

say: Step one, greet warmly, within seconds. If you are busy, say you will reply in 10 minutes, so she does not move on.

panel.heading: The six-step sales conversation
items: Recommend with benefits: one to three options

say: Step two, ask and listen. Learn the situation, reason, budget and timing, then summarise and confirm.

panel.heading: The six-step sales conversation
items: Recommend with benefits: one to three options

say: Step three, recommend one product, or at most two or three options. Too many choices make people hesitate and leave to think about it.

panel.heading: The six-step sales conversation
items: Recommend with benefits: one to three options

say: Use this pattern. Because you said the children are hard on their shoes, I recommend these leather sandals with stitched soles, which means they should last the whole term.

panel.heading: The six-step sales conversation
items: Recommend with benefits: one to three options
panel.rule: Because you said... this one... which means...

say: Step four, answer her concerns. We will look at these next.

panel.heading: The six-step sales conversation
items: Recommend with benefits: one to three options
panel.rule: Because you said... this one... which means...

say: Step five, when she asks about delivery or how to pay, help her decide. Shall I prepare the medium size for you? Then confirm every detail in writing.

panel.heading: The six-step sales conversation
items: Recommend with benefits: one to three options
panel.rule: Because you said... this one... which means...

say: Step six, follow up within a day or two. I hope the rice arrived well. It takes thirty seconds and catches problems early.

panel.heading: The six-step sales conversation
items: Recommend with benefits: one to three options
panel.rule: Because you said... this one... which means...

say: An objection is any reason she gives for not buying yet. It usually means she is interested and wants more information. First, acknowledge. I understand, you want to be sure it is worth the money.

panel.heading: Four steps for any objection
items: Respond with facts, a sample or an option

say: Second, clarify. Is it the total price, or are you comparing with another one you saw? Clarifying first stops you answering the wrong worry.

panel.heading: Four steps for any objection
items: Respond with facts, a sample or an option

say: Third, respond with a short, honest answer: facts, a sample, a guarantee or an alternative.

panel.heading: Four steps for any objection
items: Respond with facts, a sample or an option

say: Fourth, check. Does that answer your concern?

panel.heading: Four steps for any objection
items: Respond with facts, a sample or an option

say: The common mistake is dropping your price the moment someone says too expensive. It teaches customers to always push, and it eats your profit. Know your cost, your normal price and your lowest price before you start.

panel.heading: Four steps for any objection
items: Respond with facts, a sample or an option
panel.rule: Do not answer price with an immediate discount.

say: Here is the method in action. Funmi sells hair extensions online from Port Harcourt.
A customer says her 18-inch bundle at 45,000 naira is too costly, because she saw one for 30,000.
Funmi acknowledges the concern, then clarifies: was the other one human hair, and the same weight? The customer is not sure.
Funmi explains that hers is 100% human hair you can wash and reuse for many months.
Then she offers her 14-inch in the same quality for 36,000. The customer chooses it. Funmi changed the product, not her margin.
Every business gets complaints. What decides whether she comes back is how you handle it. L, listen. Let her explain fully without interrupting.

panel.heading: The LAST recovery method
items: Solve: agree a fair fix and do it fast

say: A, apologise sincerely. When Bisi's cake arrived in Ibadan with the top layer cracked, she said: I am so sorry, this is not the cake you paid for.

panel.heading: The LAST recovery method
items: Solve: agree a fair fix and do it fast

say: S, solve. Bisi decorated a plain 8-inch cake from stock, sent it by car within 90 minutes, free, and refunded 10,000 naira of the 35,000.

panel.heading: The LAST recovery method
items: Solve: agree a fair fix and do it fast

say: T, thank. Thank you for your patience today. Then Bisi fixed the cause: tiered cakes now go only by car.

panel.heading: The LAST recovery method
items: Solve: agree a fair fix and do it fast

say: Follow the order. Solving before listening usually makes the customer angrier.

panel.heading: The LAST recovery method
items: Solve: agree a fair fix and do it fast
panel.rule: Listen, Apologise, Solve, Thank. In that order.

say: Some phrases make a complaint worse. It is not my fault. You should have checked. Calm down. And worst of all, going silent.

panel.heading: What to say instead
right: Let me see how I can fix this
Thank you for sending the photos
I want to make it right

say: Say instead, let me see how I can fix this for you. Thank you for sending the photos. I want to make it right. And reply within the hour.
If she complains in public, reply once, calmly, and move to a private chat.

say: To remember. Follow the six steps every time. Treat objections as questions. Explain value before price, and never sell below your lowest price.
Handle complaints with LAST, and log every complaint so you can fix the cause.

panel.heading: Remember
items: Greet, ask, recommend, answer, agree, follow up
Value first; never sell below your lowest price
Log every complaint and fix the cause

say: Your turn. Script a sales conversation for your best-selling product. Write responses to the four objections you hear most, with your cost, normal price and lowest price. Write a LAST response to one real complaint, and start your complaints log.
